final: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS n FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id=a.district_id WHERE t.date>='1996-05-09' AND t.date<='1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS m FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.n, r.avg_signed*1.0/o.m AS ratio FROM r, o WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL
